intro.title: Hi, I'm Matt.
intro.subtitle: I build software that makes life easier.
intro.introduction: I am a software developer with a passion for building web applications. I have experience in both front-end and back-end development, and I enjoy working on projects that challenge me to learn new technologies.
intro.introductionOld: I am a frontend leaning full stack developer with an enthusiasm for building web applications and a passion for learning new technologies. I have experience in a variety of programming languages and frameworks, and I am always looking to expand my skill set.
